name.description: agent-chosen slug, stable over the schedule's lifetime; lowercase hyphen-separated (e.g. "weekly-inventory-check")

description.description: human-readable rationale; shown back to the owner when they ask what's scheduled. free-form rationale, untemplated

schedule_expression.description: EB Scheduler syntax: at(yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss) | rate(N minutes|hours|days) | cron(...). Agent generates from natural language.

timezone.description: IANA tz name (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles"); applies only to cron expressions

enabled.description: false = the schedule exists but will not fire; pause without losing the entry

start_date.description: earliest time the schedule is allowed to fire

end_date.description: latest time the schedule is allowed to fire

kind.description: agent_invocation: fire a turn on the customer's runtime; lambda: invoke a handler directly; sns: publish to a topic for fan-out

ref.description: agent_invocation: runtime endpoint ARN (defaults to tenant's own runtime); lambda: lambda ARN; sns: topic ARN

input.description: JSON payload passed to the target; for agent_invocation, arrives as user-facing content of the scheduled turn. an arbitrary agent-composed payload — the registry cannot say what is in it

created_by.description: agent_session: agent created this in a turn; terraform: provisioned at deploy (typically NOT in calendar); owner_direct: future web UI. a MECHANISM here (agent_session | terraform), not a person — unlike the ledger dimension of the same name

event_id.description: hash key; opaque id for a calendar event. created on put if omitted

subject.description: whose calendar this event is on, as a CONTACT_ID — the same reference labor's `worker_id` and inventory's `subject_contact` use. Not a gerp_profile_id: that would make having a calendar depend on being publicly listed, so a private employee could not be scheduled at all, and it would freeze 'this person is public' into a GSI hash that cannot be rewritten. Referenced, so whether a reader can name them follows their contact's profile link and can change later. GSI calendar-index hash (with starts_at as the range)

expr.description: when: an ISO date/datetime for a one-off, or an RFC 5545 RRULE for recurring (v1 indexes one-offs; recurring needs an explicit starts_at)

starts_at.description: concrete first/next occurrence, ISO — the date index (GSI calendar-index range key). defaults to expr for a one-off; range-queried for "my calendar in [window]"

description.description: human description of the event (e.g. "AcmeConf, Vegas"). free-form, untemplated

contact_id.description: optional FK into modules/contacts — a contact this event is about

invoice_id.description: optional FK into modules/invoicing — an invoice this event is about
